test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentences have been given as options. Select the option that contains a grammatical error.

Ms. Malathi is living lonely in an apartment.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Lonely'** is an adjective that describes a feeling of sadness due to a lack of companionship. (अकेला महसूस करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He felt **lonely **after moving to a new city.
 
 
 
• The adverb form **'alone'** should be used instead to describe being without others, without the connotation of sadness. (अकेले)
 
 
• **Example:** She lives** alone **in an apartment.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is** 'Ms. Malathi is living alone in__ an apartment.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'is living'** (रह रही है): This present continuous tense form is correct for describing an action happening currently.

 
 
• **Example:** She is living in New York.
 
 
 
• **'Ms. Malathi'** (सुश्री मालथी): This is the correct formal way to address a woman with the title 'Ms.' and her name.
 
 
• **Example:** Ms. Malathi is a well-known author.
 
 
 
• **'an apartment'** (एक अपार्टमेंट): This is the correct indefinite article and noun phrase.
 
 
• **Example:** She rented an apartment downtown.
